name: SimpleGraph.exists_walk_length_eq_of_descent
statement:
theorem exists_walk_length_eq_of_descent (h0 : f base = 0)
    (hdesc : ∀ v, v ≠ base → ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ f w + 1 = f v) :
    ∀ v, ∃ p : G.Walk base v, p.length = f v
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  generalize hn : f v = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases hbv : v = base
    · subst hbv
      exact ⟨.nil, by rw [h0] at hn; simpa using hn⟩
    · obtain ⟨w, hadj, hw⟩ := hdesc v hbv
      have hfw : f w = n - 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ih (n - 1) (by omega) w hfw
      refine ⟨p.concat hadj.symm, ?_⟩
      rw [Walk.length_concat, hp]
      omega

name: SimpleGraph.reachable_of_descent
statement:
theorem reachable_of_descent (h0 : f base = 0)
    (hdesc : ∀ v, v ≠ base → ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ f w + 1 = f v) (v : V) :
    G.Reachable base v
proof:
:=
  (exists_walk_length_eq_of_descent h0 hdesc v).elim fun p _ ↦ p.reachable

name: SimpleGraph.le_length_add_of_lipschitz
statement:
theorem le_length_add_of_lipschitz (hlip : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → f w ≤ f v + 1) :
    ∀ {v : V} (p : G.Walk base v), f v ≤ f base + p.length
proof:
:= by
  intro v p
  induction p with
  | nil => exact le_refl _
  | cons hadj p ih =>
    have hstep := hlip _ _ hadj
    rw [Walk.length_cons]
    omega

name: SimpleGraph.dist_eq_of_descent_of_lipschitz
statement:
theorem dist_eq_of_descent_of_lipschitz (h0 : f base = 0)
    (hdesc : ∀ v, v ≠ base → ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ f w + 1 = f v)
    (hlip : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → f w ≤ f v + 1) (v : V) :
    G.dist base v = f v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_walk_length_eq_of_descent h0 hdesc v
  have hle : G.dist base v ≤ f v := hp ▸ G.dist_le p
  have hreach : G.Reachable base v := p.reachable
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hreach.exists_walk_length_eq_dist
  have hge : f v ≤ G.dist base v := by
    have := le_length_add_of_lipschitz hlip q
    rw [h0, hq] at this
    simpa using this
  omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.card_xyz_uvw
statement:
theorem card_xyz_uvw (n N : ℕ) (F : Int → Int → Int → Prop)
    [∀ s u v, Decidable (F s u v)]
    (hxyz : ∀ x y z : Int, F (x + y + z) (x - y + z) (-x + y + z) →
      x ∈ Icc (-(n : Int)) n ∧ y ∈ Icc (-(n : Int)) n ∧ z ∈ Icc (-(n : Int)) n)
    (huvw : ∀ s u v : Int, F s u v →
      s ∈ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ∧ u ∈ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ∧ v ∈ Icc (-(N : Int)) N) :
    ((Icc (-(n : Int)) n ×ˢ Icc (-(n : Int)) n ×ˢ Icc (-(n : Int)) n).filter
        fun p => F (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2) (p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2) (-p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2)).card
      = ((Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N).filter
          fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
            F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_bij'
    (fun p _ => (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2, p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2, -p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2))
    (fun q _ => ((q.1 - q.2.2) / 2, (q.1 - q.2.1) / 2, (q.2.1 + q.2.2) / 2))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z⟩ hp
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hp ⊢
    obtain ⟨-, hF⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨hs, hu, hv⟩ := huvw _ _ _ hF
    simp only [mem_Icc] at hs hu hv
    exact ⟨⟨hs, hu, hv⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, u, v⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hq ⊢
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hF⟩ := hq
    have hx : (s - v) / 2 + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = s := by omega
    have hy : (s - v) / 2 - (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = u := by omega
    have hz : -((s - v) / 2) + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = v := by omega
    rw [hx, hy, hz]
    obtain ⟨hxb, hyb, hzb⟩ := hxyz ((s - v) / 2) ((s - u) / 2) ((u + v) / 2)
      (by rw [hx, hy, hz]; exact hF)
    simp only [mem_Icc] at hxb hyb hzb
    exact ⟨⟨hxb, hyb, hzb⟩, hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z⟩ _
    have h1 : (x + y + z - (-x + y + z)) / 2 = x := by omega
    have h2 : (x + y + z - (x - y + z)) / 2 = y := by omega
    have h3 : (x - y + z + (-x + y + z)) / 2 = z := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, h3]
  · rintro ⟨s, u, v⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hq
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨hp1, hp2⟩, -⟩ := hq
    have h1 : (s - v) / 2 + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = s := by omega
    have h2 : (s - v) / 2 - (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = u := by omega
    have h3 : -((s - v) / 2) + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = v := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, h3]

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard_D2_eq_uvw
statement:
theorem levelCard_D2_eq_uvw (n : ℕ) :
    levelCard D2 n =
      ((Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int) ×ˢ
          Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int) ×ˢ
          Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)).filter
        fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
          F2 (n : Int) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold levelCard
  have hfilt : (Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ
      Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int)).filter (fun p => D2 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = (n : Int))
      = (Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ
      Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int)).filter
        (fun p => F2 (n : Int) (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2) (p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2)
          (-p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2)) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro p _
    exact D2_eq_F2 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 n
  rw [hfilt]
  apply card_xyz_uvw n (2 * n + 2) (F2 (n : Int))
  · intro x y z hF
    unfold F2 at hF
    simp only [mem_Icc]
    omega
  · intro s u v hF
    unfold F2 at hF
    simp only [mem_Icc]
    omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.even_count_in_interval
statement:
theorem even_count_in_interval (k : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)).card = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => decide
  | succ m ih =>
    have hexp : (Finset.Icc (-((m : Int) + 1)) ((m : Int) + 1 + 1))
        = insert (-((m : Int) + 1)) (insert ((m : Int) + 2) (Finset.Icc (-(m : Int)) (m + 1 : Int))) := by
      ext v; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega
    push_cast
    rw [hexp, Finset.filter_insert, Finset.filter_insert]
    rcases Int.emod_two_eq (m : Int) with hm | hm
    · have h1 : ¬ ((-((m : Int) + 1)) % 2 = 0) := by omega
      have h2 : ((m : Int) + 2) % 2 = 0 := by omega
      simp only [h1, h2, if_false, if_true]
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, ih]
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
    · have h1 : ((-((m : Int) + 1)) % 2 = 0) := by omega
      have h2 : ¬ (((m : Int) + 2) % 2 = 0) := by omega
      simp only [h1, h2, if_false, if_true]
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, ih]
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.odd_count_in_interval
statement:
theorem odd_count_in_interval (k : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)).card = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have htot : (Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).card = 2 * k + 2 := by
    rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  have hsplit : (Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int))
      = (Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0) ∪
        (Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1) := by
    ext v; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter]; omega
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0))
      ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro v _ hv0 hv1
    omega
  have := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
  rw [← hsplit, htot, even_count_in_interval] at this
  omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.coord_constraint_iff
statement:
theorem coord_constraint_iff (k : ℕ) (v : Int) :
    (-((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) ≤ 2 * v - 1 ∧ 2 * v - 1 ≤ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int)) ↔
      -(k : Int) ≤ v ∧ v ≤ (k : Int) + 1
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.ballF2_card
statement:
theorem ballF2_card (N k : ℕ) (hN : 2 * k + 1 ≤ N) :
    (ballF2 N (2 * k + 1)).card = 2 * (k + 1) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hIe_card : ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)).card
      = k + 1 := even_count_in_interval k
  have hIo_card : ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)).card
      = k + 1 := odd_count_in_interval k
  set I := Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int) with hI
  set Ie := I.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0) with hIe
  set Io := I.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1) with hIo
  have heq : ballF2 N (2 * k + 1) = (Ie ×ˢ Ie ×ˢ Ie) ∪ (Io ×ˢ Io ×ˢ Io) := by
    unfold ballF2
    ext ⟨a, b, c⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_union, hIe, hIo, hI, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, hb, hc⟩, ⟨hab, hbc⟩, hsa, hsb, hsc⟩
      rw [coord_constraint_iff] at hsa hsb hsc
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq a with h0 | h1
      · left; exact ⟨⟨hsa, by omega⟩, ⟨hsb, by omega⟩, ⟨hsc, by omega⟩⟩
      · right; exact ⟨⟨hsa, by omega⟩, ⟨hsb, by omega⟩, ⟨hsc, by omega⟩⟩
    · rintro (⟨⟨ha, h1⟩, ⟨hb, h2⟩, ⟨hc, h3⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨ha, h1⟩, ⟨hb, h2⟩, ⟨hc, h3⟩⟩) <;>
      · have hsa := (coord_constraint_iff k a).mpr ha
        have hsb := (coord_constraint_iff k b).mpr hb
        have hsc := (coord_constraint_iff k c).mpr hc
        exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hsa, hsb, hsc⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ie ×ˢ Ie ×ˢ Ie) (Io ×ˢ Io ×ˢ Io) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩ ha hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, hIe, hIo, Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
    omega
  rw [heq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product,
    Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, hIe_card, hIo_card]
  ring

name: Bcs.CountOdd.F2Card_eq_ball_diff
statement:
theorem F2Card_eq_ball_diff (N k : ℕ) (hN : 2 * k + 1 ≤ N) :
    ((Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N).filter
        fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
          F2 ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
      = (ballF2 N (2 * k + 1)).card - (ballF2 N (2 * k - 1)).card
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hkpos
  · subst hk0
    simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    have hempty : ballF2 N (2 * 0 - 1) = ∅ := by
      unfold ballF2
      apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
      rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩ _ ⟨-, hsa, -, -⟩
      omega
    rw [hempty]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.sub_zero]
    congr 1
    unfold ballF2
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro p _
    unfold F2
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hpar, hbound, hor⟩
      exact ⟨hpar, hbound⟩
    · rintro ⟨hpar, hbound⟩
      exact ⟨hpar, hbound, by omega⟩
  · have hsub : ballF2 N (2 * k - 1) ⊆ ballF2 N (2 * k + 1) :=
      ballF2_mono N (by omega)
    have hcard_diff : (ballF2 N (2 * k + 1)).card - (ballF2 N (2 * k - 1)).card
        = ((ballF2 N (2 * k + 1)) \ (ballF2 N (2 * k - 1))).card := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub]
    rw [hcard_diff]
    congr 1
    unfold ballF2
    ext ⟨a, b, c⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    unfold F2
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound, hor⟩
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨-, -, hsa, hsb, hsc⟩
      omega
    · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound⟩, hnotin⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound, ?_⟩
      by_contra hor
      push Not at hor

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard_D2_closed
statement: theorem levelCard_D2_closed (k : ℕ) : levelCard D2 (2 * k + 1) = 6 * k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelCard_D2_eq_uvw]
  have hN : 2 * k + 1 ≤ 2 * (2 * k + 1) + 2 := by omega
  rw [F2Card_eq_ball_diff (2 * (2 * k + 1) + 2) k hN]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hkpos
  · subst hk0; decide
  · have hk1 : 2 * k - 1 = 2 * (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hk1]
    rw [ballF2_card (2 * (2*k+1) + 2) k (by omega),
        ballF2_card (2 * (2*k+1) + 2) (k-1) (by omega)]
    have hk' : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    rw [hk']
    have : 2 * (k+1)^3 ≥ 2 * k ^ 3 := by nlinarith
    zify [this]
    ring

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard8base_eq_uvw
statement:
theorem levelCard8base_eq_uvw (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    levelCard8base n =
      ((Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int) ×ˢ
          Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int) ×ˢ
          Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)).filter
        fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
          F8 (n : Int) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold levelCard8base
  have hfilt : (Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ
      Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int)).filter (fun p => D8base p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = (n : Int))
      = (Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ
      Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int)).filter
        (fun p => F8 (n : Int) (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2) (p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2)
          (-p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2)) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro p _
    exact D8base_eq_F8 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 n
  rw [hfilt]
  apply card_xyz_uvw n (2 * n + 2) (F8 (n : Int))
  · intro x y z hF
    unfold F8 at hF
    simp only [mem_Icc]
    omega
  · intro s u v hF
    unfold F8 at hF
    simp only [mem_Icc]

name: Bcs.CountOdd.even_count_in_interval_shift
statement:
theorem even_count_in_interval_shift (k : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)).card = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)
      = ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)).image
        (fun v => v + 1) := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      exact ⟨v - 1, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, rfl⟩
      omega
  rw [heq, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b hab => by omega), odd_count_in_interval]

name: Bcs.CountOdd.odd_count_in_interval_shift
statement:
theorem odd_count_in_interval_shift (k : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)).card = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have htot : (Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).card = 2 * k + 2 := by
    rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  have hsplit : (Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int))
      = (Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0) ∪
        (Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1) := by
    ext v; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter]; omega
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0))
      ((Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro v _ hv0 hv1
    omega
  have := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
  rw [← hsplit, htot, even_count_in_interval_shift] at this
  omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.coord_constraint8_u_iff
statement:
theorem coord_constraint8_u_iff (k : ℕ) (v : Int) :
    (-((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) ≤ 2 * v - 3 ∧ 2 * v - 3 ≤ ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int)) ↔
      1 - (k : Int) ≤ v ∧ v ≤ (k : Int) + 2
proof: := by omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.ballF8_card
statement:
theorem ballF8_card (N k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (_hN : 2 * k + 1 ≤ N) :
    (ballF8 N (2 * k + 1)).card = 2 * (k + 1) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hIe_card : ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)).card
      = k + 1 := even_count_in_interval k
  have hIo_card : ((Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)).card
      = k + 1 := odd_count_in_interval k
  have hJe_card : ((Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)).card
      = k + 1 := even_count_in_interval_shift k
  have hJo_card : ((Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int)).filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1)).card
      = k + 1 := odd_count_in_interval_shift k
  set I := Finset.Icc (-(k : Int)) (k + 1 : Int) with hI
  set J := Finset.Icc (1 - (k : Int)) (k + 2 : Int) with hJ
  set Ie := I.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0) with hIe
  set Io := I.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1) with hIo
  set Je := J.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0) with hJe
  set Jo := J.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 1) with hJo
  have heq : ballF8 N (2 * k + 1) = (Ie ×ˢ Je ×ˢ Je) ∪ (Io ×ˢ Jo ×ˢ Jo) := by
    unfold ballF8
    ext ⟨a, b, c⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_union, hIe, hIo, hJe, hJo,
      hI, hJ, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, hb, hc⟩, ⟨hab, hbc⟩, hsa, hsb, hsc⟩
      rw [coord_constraint_iff] at hsa
      rw [coord_constraint8_u_iff] at hsb hsc
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq a with h0 | h1
      · left; exact ⟨⟨hsa, by omega⟩, ⟨hsb, by omega⟩, ⟨hsc, by omega⟩⟩
      · right; exact ⟨⟨hsa, by omega⟩, ⟨hsb, by omega⟩, ⟨hsc, by omega⟩⟩
    · rintro (⟨⟨ha, h1⟩, ⟨hb, h2⟩, ⟨hc, h3⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨ha, h1⟩, ⟨hb, h2⟩, ⟨hc, h3⟩⟩) <;>
      · have hsa := (coord_constraint_iff k a).mpr ha
        have hsb := (coord_constraint8_u_iff k b).mpr hb
        have hsc := (coord_constraint8_u_iff k c).mpr hc
        exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hsa, hsb, hsc⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ie ×ˢ Je ×ˢ Je) (Io ×ˢ Jo ×ˢ Jo) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩ ha hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, hIe, hIo, Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
    omega
  rw [heq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product,
    Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, hIe_card, hJe_card, hIo_card, hJo_card]
  ring

name: Bcs.CountOdd.F8Card_eq_ball_diff
statement:
theorem F8Card_eq_ball_diff (N k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (_hN : 2 * k + 1 ≤ N) :
    ((Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N).filter
        fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
          F8 ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
      = (ballF8 N (2 * k + 1)).card - (ballF8 N (2 * k - 1)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ballF8 N (2 * k - 1) ⊆ ballF8 N (2 * k + 1) := ballF8_mono N (by omega)
  have hcard_diff : (ballF8 N (2 * k + 1)).card - (ballF8 N (2 * k - 1)).card
      = ((ballF8 N (2 * k + 1)) \ (ballF8 N (2 * k - 1))).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub]
  rw [hcard_diff]
  congr 1
  unfold ballF8
  ext ⟨a, b, c⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
  unfold F8
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound, hor⟩
    refine ⟨⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨-, -, hsa, hsb, hsc⟩
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound⟩, hnotin⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, hbound, ?_⟩
    by_contra hor
    push Not at hor
    apply hnotin
    refine ⟨⟨hboxa, hboxb, hboxc⟩, hpar, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard8base_1
statement: theorem levelCard8base_1 : levelCard8base 1 = 1
proof: := by unfold levelCard8base; decide

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard8base_closed
statement:
theorem levelCard8base_closed (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    levelCard8base (2 * k + 1) = 6 * k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelCard8base_eq_uvw (2 * k + 1) (by omega)]
  have hN : 2 * k + 1 ≤ 2 * (2 * k + 1) + 2 := by omega
  rw [F8Card_eq_ball_diff (2 * (2 * k + 1) + 2) k hk hN]
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hk with hk1 | hk1
  · rw [← hk1]; decide +kernel
  · have hk1' : 2 ≤ k := by omega
    have hk2 : 2 * k - 1 = 2 * (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hk2]
    rw [ballF8_card (2 * (2 * k + 1) + 2) k hk (by omega),
        ballF8_card (2 * (2 * k + 1) + 2) (k - 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
    have hk' : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    rw [hk']
    have : 2 * (k + 1) ^ 3 ≥ 2 * k ^ 3 := by nlinarith
    zify [this]
    ring

name: Bcs.CountOdd.lineAtLevel_card
statement:
theorem lineAtLevel_card (M : Int) (m : ℕ) (hM : (m : Int) + 1 ≤ M) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : m % 2 = 1) :
    ((Finset.Icc (-M) M).filter (fun t => D8base t t (1 - t) = (m : Int))).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (Finset.Icc (-M) M).filter
      (fun t => D8base t t (1 - t) = (m : Int)) = {((m : Int) - 1) / 2, (-(m : Int) - 1) / 2} := by
    ext t
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
      D8base_line]
    omega
  rw [heq]
  have hne : ((m : Int) - 1) / 2 ≠ (-(m : Int) - 1) / 2 := by omega
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hne]), Finset.card_singleton]

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard_D8_eq_base
statement:
theorem levelCard_D8_eq_base (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    levelCard D8 (2 * k + 1) = levelCard8base (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold levelCard levelCard8base
  set n : Int := ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) with hn
  set A := (Finset.Icc (-n) n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-n) n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-n) n).filter
      (fun p => D8 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = n) with hA
  set B := (Finset.Icc (-n) n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-n) n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-n) n).filter
      (fun p => D8base p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = n) with hB
  have key : ∀ p : Int × Int × Int, p ∈ A ↔
      (p ∈ B ∧ ¬(p.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2 = 1 - p.1)) ∨
      (p.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2 = 1 - p.1 ∧ D8base p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = n - 2 ∧
        -n ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ n ∧ -n ≤ p.2.1 ∧ p.2.1 ≤ n ∧ -n ≤ p.2.2 ∧ p.2.2 ≤ n) := by
    intro p
    rw [hA, hB]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, heqn⟩
      rw [D8_eq_base_add_bump] at heqn
      by_cases hbump : p.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2 = 1 - p.1
      · right
        rw [if_pos hbump] at heqn
        exact ⟨hbump.1, hbump.2, by omega, hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2, hz.1, hz.2⟩
      · left
        rw [if_neg hbump] at heqn
        exact ⟨⟨⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, by omega⟩, hbump⟩
    · rintro (⟨⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, heqb⟩, hbump⟩ | ⟨hxy, hz1, hbase, hx1, hx2, hy1, hy2, hz1', hz2⟩)
      · refine ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [D8_eq_base_add_bump, if_neg hbump]
        omega
      · refine ⟨⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ⟨hz1', hz2⟩⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [D8_eq_base_add_bump, if_pos ⟨hxy, hz1⟩]
        omega
  set D := B.filter (fun p => p.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2 = 1 - p.1) with hD
  set C := (Finset.Icc (-n) n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-n) n ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-n) n).filter
      (fun p => p.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2 = 1 - p.1 ∧ D8base p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = n - 2) with hC
  have hAeq : A = (B \ D) ∪ C := by
    ext p
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, hD, hC]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    rw [key p]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hpb, hnb⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9⟩)
      · left; exact ⟨hpb, fun hcon => hnb hcon.2⟩
      · right; exact ⟨⟨⟨h4, h5⟩, ⟨h6, h7⟩, h8, h9⟩, h1, h2, h3⟩
    · rintro (⟨hpb, hnd⟩ | ⟨⟨⟨h4, h5⟩, ⟨h6, h7⟩, h8, h9⟩, h1, h2, h3⟩)
      · left; exact ⟨hpb, fun hcon => hnd ⟨hpb, hcon⟩⟩
      · right; exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (B \ D) C := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro p hp1 hp2
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, hD] at hp1
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hp1
    rw [hC] at hp2
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hp2
    exact hp1.2 ⟨hp1.1, hp2.2.1, hp2.2.2.1⟩
  have hDsub : D ⊆ B := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hDcard : D.card = 2 := by
    have hbij : D = (Finset.filter (fun t => D8base t t (1 - t) = n)
        (Finset.Icc (-n - 1) (n + 1))).image (fun t => (t, t, 1 - t)) := by
      rw [hD, hB]
      ext ⟨px, py, pz⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_image,
        Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩, hz1', hz2⟩, heqb⟩, hxy, hz1⟩
        exact ⟨px, ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by rw [← hxy] at heqb; rw [← hz1]; exact heqb⟩,
          rfl, hxy, hz1.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨t, ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, heqt⟩, hpx, hpy, hpz⟩
        subst hpx; subst hpy; subst hpz
        have hline := D8base_line t
        rw [heqt] at hline
        have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; positivity
        exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by omega, by omega⟩, heqt⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [hbij, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b hab => by simpa using hab)]
    have hnval : n = ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) := hn
    rw [hnval]
    exact lineAtLevel_card (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : Int) + 1) (2 * k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega)
  have hCcard : C.card = 2 := by
    have hbij : C = (Finset.filter (fun t => D8base t t (1 - t) = n - 2)
        (Finset.Icc (-n - 1) (n + 1))).image (fun t => (t, t, 1 - t)) := by
      rw [hC]
      ext ⟨px, py, pz⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_image,
        Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩, hz1', hz2⟩, hxy, hz1, hbase⟩
        exact ⟨px, ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by rw [← hxy] at hbase; rw [← hz1]; exact hbase⟩,
          rfl, hxy, hz1.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨t, ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, heqt⟩, hpx, hpy, hpz⟩
        subst hpx; subst hpy; subst hpz
        have hline := D8base_line t
        rw [heqt] at hline
        have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; positivity
        exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, rfl, rfl, heqt⟩
    rw [hbij, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b hab => by simpa using hab)]
    have hnval : n - 2 = ((2 * k - 1 : ℕ) : Int) := by rw [hn]; omega
    rw [hnval]
    exact lineAtLevel_card (n + 1) (2 * k - 1) (by rw [hn]; omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hAcard : A.card = (B \ D).card + C.card := by
    rw [hAeq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
  have hBcard : D.card ≤ B.card := Finset.card_le_card hDsub
  rw [hAcard, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hDsub, hDcard, hCcard] at *
  omega

name: Bcs.CountOdd.levelCard_D8_closed
statement:
theorem levelCard_D8_closed (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    levelCard D8 (2 * k + 1) = 6 * k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 2

name: Bcs.walk_dist
statement: theorem walk_dist (s : St) : Walk (D s).toNat s
proof:
:= by
  generalize hn : (D s).toNat = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing s with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases hb : s = base
    · subst hb
      have : (D base).toNat = 0 := by
        have := (d_zero_iff base).mpr rfl
        omega
      simpa [← hn, this] using Walk.nil
    · obtain ⟨t, hadj, hdt⟩ := descent_step s hb
      have hspos : 0 < D s := lt_of_le_of_ne (d_nonneg s) (Ne.symm (mt (d_zero_iff s).mp hb))
      have htnat : (D t).toNat = n - 1 := by omega
      have hwt : Walk (n - 1) t := by
        have := ih (n - 1) (by omega) t htnat
        exact this
      have : Walk (n - 1 + 1) s := Walk.cons hwt hadj
      have hn1 : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
      rwa [hn1] at this

name: Bcs.dist_le_walk
statement: theorem dist_le_walk {n : Nat} {s : St} (h : Walk n s) : (D s).toNat ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil =>
    have : D base = 0 := (d_zero_iff base).mpr rfl
    simp [this]
  | cons hw hadj ih =>
    rename_i n s t
    rcases adj_dist_step hadj with hd | hd
    · omega
    · omega

name: Bcs.dist_is_least
statement: theorem dist_is_least (s : St) : IsLeast {n : Nat | Walk n s} (D s).toNat
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact walk_dist s
  · intro n hn
    exact dist_le_walk hn

proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp only [mem_sphere_iff, Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_product,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  obtain ⟨v, x, y, z⟩ := s
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hpos : 0 ≤ D (v, x, y, z) := d_nonneg _
    have hDn : D (v, x, y, z) = (n : Int) := by omega
    have hbox := dist_box v x y z n hDn
    refine ⟨?_, hDn⟩
    simp only [box, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := hbox
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, hDn⟩
    have : 0 ≤ D (v, x, y, z) := d_nonneg _
    omega

          first
            | omega
            | (rw [hx, hy, hz];

                 | exact Adj.e0_12 x y z    | exact Adj.e1_12 x y z
                 | exact Adj.e2_13 x y z    | exact Adj.e3_13 x y z
                 | exact Adj.e4_14 x y z    | exact Adj.e5_14 x y z

name: Bcs.shellCard_eq_sum
statement:
theorem shellCard_eq_sum (n : ℕ) :
    shellCard n = ∑ v : Fin 8, classCard v n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold shellCard classCard
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    (f := Prod.fst) (t := (univ : Finset (Fin 8))) (fun s _ => mem_univ s.1)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
  refine Finset.card_bij' (fun s _ => s.2) (fun p _ => (v, p)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro s hs
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hs ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨hbox, hD⟩, hfst⟩ := hs
    rw [← hfst]
    exact ⟨hbox, hD⟩
  · intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1, hp.2⟩, trivial⟩
  · intro s hs
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hs
    obtain ⟨w, p2⟩ := s
    obtain ⟨-, hfst⟩ := hs
    subst hfst
    rfl
  · intro p _
    rfl

name: Bcs.CountEven.card_xyz_uvw
statement:
theorem card_xyz_uvw (n N : ℕ) (F : Int → Int → Int → Prop)
    [∀ s u v, Decidable (F s u v)]
    (hxyz : ∀ x y z : Int, F (x + y + z) (x - y + z) (-x + y + z) →
      x ∈ Icc (-(n : Int)) n ∧ y ∈ Icc (-(n : Int)) n ∧ z ∈ Icc (-(n : Int)) n)
    (huvw : ∀ s u v : Int, F s u v →
      s ∈ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ∧ u ∈ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ∧ v ∈ Icc (-(N : Int)) N) :
    ((Icc (-(n : Int)) n ×ˢ Icc (-(n : Int)) n ×ˢ Icc (-(n : Int)) n).filter
        fun p => F (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2) (p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2) (-p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2)).card
      = ((Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N : Int)) N).filter
          fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
            F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_bij'
    (fun p _ => (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2, p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2, -p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2))
    (fun q _ => ((q.1 - q.2.2) / 2, (q.1 - q.2.1) / 2, (q.2.1 + q.2.2) / 2))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z⟩ hp
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hp ⊢
    obtain ⟨-, hF⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨hs, hu, hv⟩ := huvw _ _ _ hF
    simp only [mem_Icc] at hs hu hv
    exact ⟨⟨hs, hu, hv⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, u, v⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hq ⊢
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hF⟩ := hq
    have hx : (s - v) / 2 + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = s := by omega
    have hy : (s - v) / 2 - (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = u := by omega
    have hz : -((s - v) / 2) + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = v := by omega
    rw [hx, hy, hz]
    obtain ⟨hxb, hyb, hzb⟩ := hxyz ((s - v) / 2) ((s - u) / 2) ((u + v) / 2)
      (by rw [hx, hy, hz]; exact hF)
    simp only [mem_Icc] at hxb hyb hzb
    exact ⟨⟨hxb, hyb, hzb⟩, hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z⟩ _
    have h1 : (x + y + z - (-x + y + z)) / 2 = x := by omega
    have h2 : (x + y + z - (x - y + z)) / 2 = y := by omega
    have h3 : (x - y + z + (-x + y + z)) / 2 = z := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, h3]
  · rintro ⟨s, u, v⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hq
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨hp1, hp2⟩, -⟩ := hq
    have h1 : (s - v) / 2 + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = s := by omega
    have h2 : (s - v) / 2 - (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = u := by omega
    have h3 : -((s - v) / 2) + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = v := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, h3]

statement:
theorem levelCard_D5_eq_uvw (n : ℕ) :
    levelCard D5 n =
      ((Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int) ×ˢ
          Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int) ×ˢ
          Icc (-((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)) ((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : Int)).filter
        fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
          F5 (n : Int) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold levelCard
  have hfilt : (Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ
      Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int)).filter (fun p => D5 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 = (n : Int))
      = (Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int) ×ˢ
      Finset.Icc (-(n : Int)) (n : Int)).filter
        (fun p => F5 (n : Int) (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2) (p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2)
          (-p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2)) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro p _
    exact D5_eq_F5 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 n
  rw [hfilt]
  apply card_xyz_uvw n (2 * n + 2) (F5 (n : Int))
  · intro x y z hF
    unfold F5 at hF
    simp only [mem_Icc]
    omega
  · intro s u v hF
    unfold F5 at hF
    simp only [mem_Icc]
    omega

        Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor

        refine ⟨px, ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩, rfl, by omega, by omega⟩

          omega
        exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, rfl, by omega, ht0, heqt⟩
    rw [hbij, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b hab => by simpa using hab)]
    have hnval : n - 2 = ((2 * (k - 1) : ℕ) : Int) := by rw [hn]; omega
    rw [hnval]
    exact lineAtLevel1_card (n + 1) (2 * (k - 1)) (by rw [hn]; omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hAcard : A.card = (B \ D).card + C.card := by
    rw [hAeq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
  have hBcard : D.card ≤ B.card := Finset.card_le_card hDsub
  rw [hAcard, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hDsub, hDcard, hCcard] at *
  omega

name: Bcs.bcs_coordination

theorem bcs_coordination (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    (sphere n).ncard = 6 * n ^ 2 + 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
  · subst hk
    have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
    simpa [two_mul] using bcs_coordination_even k hk2
  · subst hk
    have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
    exact bcs_coordination_odd k hk1

name: Bcs.card_filter_prod3
statement:
theorem card_filter_prod3 (A B C : Finset Int) (P Q R : Int → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] [DecidablePred R] :
    ((A ×ˢ B ×ˢ C).filter fun p => P p.1 ∧ Q p.2.1 ∧ R p.2.2).card
      = (A.filter P).card * (B.filter Q).card * (C.filter R).card
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((A ×ˢ B ×ˢ C).filter fun p => P p.1 ∧ Q p.2.1 ∧ R p.2.2)
      = A.filter P ×ˢ ((B ×ˢ C).filter fun q => Q q.1 ∧ R q.2) := by
    rw [← filter_product]
  rw [h1, card_product, filter_product, card_product, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: Bcs.card_xyz_uvw
statement:
theorem card_xyz_uvw (n N : ℕ) (F : Int → Int → Int → Prop)
    [∀ s u v, Decidable (F s u v)]
    (hxyz : ∀ x y z : Int, F (x+y+z) (x-y+z) (-x+y+z) →
      x ∈ Icc (-(n:Int)) n ∧ y ∈ Icc (-(n:Int)) n ∧ z ∈ Icc (-(n:Int)) n)
    (huvw : ∀ s u v : Int, F s u v →
      s ∈ Icc (-(N:Int)) N ∧ u ∈ Icc (-(N:Int)) N ∧ v ∈ Icc (-(N:Int)) N) :
    ((Icc (-(n:Int)) n ×ˢ Icc (-(n:Int)) n ×ˢ Icc (-(n:Int)) n).filter
        fun p => F (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2) (p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2) (-p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2)).card
      = ((Icc (-(N:Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N:Int)) N ×ˢ Icc (-(N:Int)) N).filter
          fun q => (q.1 % 2 = q.2.1 % 2 ∧ q.2.1 % 2 = q.2.2 % 2) ∧
            F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2).card
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_bij'
    (fun p _ => (p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2, p.1 - p.2.1 + p.2.2, -p.1 + p.2.1 + p.2.2))
    (fun q _ => ((q.1 - q.2.2) / 2, (q.1 - q.2.1) / 2, (q.2.1 + q.2.2) / 2))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z⟩ hp
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hp ⊢
    obtain ⟨-, hF⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨hs, hu, hv⟩ := huvw _ _ _ hF
    simp only [mem_Icc] at hs hu hv
    exact ⟨⟨hs, hu, hv⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, u, v⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hq ⊢
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hF⟩ := hq
    have hx : (s - v) / 2 + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = s := by omega
    have hy : (s - v) / 2 - (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = u := by omega
    have hz : -((s - v) / 2) + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = v := by omega
    rw [hx, hy, hz]
    obtain ⟨hxb, hyb, hzb⟩ := hxyz ((s - v) / 2) ((s - u) / 2) ((u + v) / 2)
      (by rw [hx, hy, hz]; exact hF)
    simp only [mem_Icc] at hxb hyb hzb
    exact ⟨⟨hxb, hyb, hzb⟩, hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z⟩ _
    have h1 : (x + y + z - (-x + y + z)) / 2 = x := by omega
    have h2 : (x + y + z - (x - y + z)) / 2 = y := by omega
    have h3 : (x - y + z + (-x + y + z)) / 2 = z := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, h3]
  · rintro ⟨s, u, v⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hq
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨hp1, hp2⟩, -⟩ := hq
    have h1 : (s - v) / 2 + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = s := by omega
    have h2 : (s - v) / 2 - (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = u := by omega
    have h3 : -((s - v) / 2) + (s - u) / 2 + (u + v) / 2 = v := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, h3]
